about: Daily entries and gratitudes, one row a day. A year later, that day's entry comes back on Telegram.

table.name: Journal
table._comment_candidateFields: Shown to the planner alongside each candidate so an update can merge rather than clobber - it needs to see the gratitudes already on today's row before rewriting the field.
conventions: Gratitudes go one per line in the Gratitudes field, no numbering or bullets - just the things. Record only what they actually said; never invent one to round out a list.
Gratitudes are often recorded on their own ('Gratitudes. Coffee, the walk this morning, a friend calling') rather than inside a full entry. That is still this table.

One row per day. If a Journal record already exists for the recording's date, update that record instead of creating a second one - a gratitudes recording in the evening belongs on the same row as the morning's entry. Only set the fields this recording actually provides; never overwrite a field it says nothing about.
When updating a row that already has Gratitudes, include the existing ones alongside the new - an update replaces the field wholesale.
